@@U02824@@
[ve seen such princesses before. I'd say she’s quite perfect from head to toe.

@@U02826@@
She’s approaching the sleeper with gentle guile. i LADY: How ugly beside his pure youthful image.

@@U02828@@
Her beauty bathes him in her radiance.

@@U02830@@
Just like the painting, Endymion and Luna.

@@U02832@@
Quite right. She seems to be sinking now, bending to breathe in the breath of his lips. Enviable! A kiss! His cup runs over!

@@U02834@@
Imagine! In front of everyone! Too much!

@@U02836@@
What right has that boy to such favors!

@@U02838@@
Quiet! Keep it down there! Let the spook do what it likes.

@@U02840@@
She’s tiptoeing away as he wakens.
translation:
@@U02824@@
【以前见过这样的公主。我想说她从头到脚都很完美。

@@U02826@@
她带着温柔的狡诈接近熟睡的人。 i LADY：和他清纯的青春形象相比，真丑啊。

@@U02828@@
她的美丽使他沐浴在她的光芒之中。

@@U02830@@
就像画中的恩底弥翁和卢娜一样。

@@U02832@@
完全正确。她现在似乎正在下沉，弯下腰去呼吸他嘴唇上的气息。令人羡慕！一个吻！他的杯子溢出来了！

@@U02834@@
想象一下！当着所有人的面！太多了！

@@U02836@@
那小子有什么资格得到这样的恩惠！

@@U02838@@
安静！把它放在那里！让幽灵做它喜欢做的事吧。

@@U02840@@
当他醒来时，她正蹑手蹑脚地走开。
